nodes.label: "Default and partial requests are rejected before any evaluation"
"A straight source offsets exactly to either side"
"A parabola's offset follows its exact normals"
"A circular arc offsets to a concentric arc"
"An S-curve offsets on both sides through its inflection"
"The offset is regular or it is refused"
"A kink is rounded where it turns away from the offset, its sides overlap where it turns towards it"
"A cusp hidden at a join where the curvature jumps splits the offset there"
"The nearest point just before a closed curve's seam decides the side"
"A click outside a sharp turn at a closed curve's seam still has a side"
"The sample limit counts every branch of a cusped offset"
"A direction point on the curve has no side"
"Reversing the source swaps the side a point selects, not the offset"
"Closed sources offset to a closed chain; a flag without a seam is refused"
"Offsets stay accurate far from the origin"
"Caps end the offset with no branch"
"A branch materializes as one cubic spline whose spans are its validated pieces"
"A straight source materializes as one exact line"
"Output copies only the source's layer and pen"
"A closed source materializes as one open spline whose ends meet in a smooth stretch"
"Inside its radius of curvature the offset is one branch; past it, it splits at the cusps"
"A swallowtail within twice the merge tolerance is collapsed before anything else"
"At a radius of curvature the offset stalls and runs on, one branch"
"A stall is found whatever the curve's orientation"
"Near the radius of curvature the offset fits far from the origin too"
"A stall across a closed curve's seam closes the branch"
"Cusp branches materialize as entities meeting at the cusps"
"A closed source's cusped offset is a cycle of open branches"
"A tiny reversed branch at an end of a closed chain collapses across the seam"
"A closed source's branches are joined and collapsed around their ring"
"A hyperbola is offset along its exact curve on either branch and either side"
"A hyperbola whose ends run backwards is offset all the same"
"A hyperbola past its vertex's radius of curvature is trimmed"
"A cubic with a doubled control point offsets through it along the tangent's limit"
"Where a vanishing tangent tends to different directions, the source turns a corner there"
"A repeated vertex of a polyline spline changes nothing"
"A knot interval over which a spline stands still is skipped"
"Three or more corners trimmed past their cusp distance in the same offset stay symmetric"
